import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # bar color appears in row 0; marker color otherwise
    row0=set(grid[0]); bar_color=[c for c in others if c in row0]
    # if both in row0 pick... assume one
    bar_color=bar_color[0] if bar_color else others[0]
    mk_color=[c for c in others if c!=bar_color][0]
    # top bar run in row 0
    j0=grid[0].index(bar_color)
    j1=j0
    while j1+1<w and grid[0][j1+1]==bar_color: j1+=1
    # bottom bar run in last row
    iB=h-1
    k0=grid[iB].index(bar_color); k1=k0
    while k1+1<w and grid[iB][k1+1]==bar_color: k1+=1
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    markers=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==mk_color]
    for (i,j) in markers:
        off=j-j0
        jc=k0+off
        # vertical line from below top bar down to marker
        for r in range(1,i+1):
            out[r][j]=mk_color
        out[i][j]=4
        # vertical line in bottom bar column, up to top edge
        for r in range(0,iB):
            out[r][jc]=mk_color
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
    exp=G[k.replace('input','output')]
    got=transform(G[k])
    print(k, got==exp)
res=transform(G['Test input'])
import json
print(json.dumps(res))
